name: review-pack
title: Invoice review record
for_each: select id,code from invoices order by code

sections.title: Evidence gaps
sections.sql: select rule,finding from invoice_exceptions where id=$1 order by rule

sections.title: Line detail
sections.sql: select line_number,description,net_cents from invoice_lines where invoice_id=$1 order by line_number

sections.title: Review history
sections.sql: select kind,actor,note,created_at from events where entity_id=$1 order by created_at

name: handoff
title: Draft accounting handoff
for_each: select id,code from invoices i where status='ready' and not exists(select 1 from invoice_exceptions e where e.id=i.id) order by code

sections.title: Reviewed invoice, not a payment instruction
Review evidence
sections.sql: select review_ref,tax_jurisdiction,tax_evidence from invoices where id=$1
